## ⚠️ Breaking changes

`connection.blobAsText` has been removed. It converted *every* blob to a string, which corrupted binary blobs.

Use the new top-level `fetchAsString` option instead, which only converts text blobs (`BLOB SUB_TYPE TEXT`) and leaves binary blobs as `Buffer`s:

```diff
 const knex = knexLib({
   client: knexFirebirdAdapter,
   connection: {
     /* ... */
-    blobAsText: true,
   },
+  fetchAsString: ['textblob'],
 });
```

Without this change, text blobs are returned as `Buffer`s again. A leftover `blobAsText` has no effect and logs a warning at startup.

## ✨ Added

- Top-level `fetchAsString` option, following Knex's Oracle client ([docs](https://knexjs.org/guide/#fetchasstring)):
  - `'textblob'` (alias `'clob'`): text blobs as UTF-8 strings; binary blobs stay `Buffer`s.
  - `'number'`: numeric columns as strings (from the driver's double precision value).
  - `'date'`: `DATE`, `TIME`, `TIMESTAMP` and their `WITH TIME ZONE` variants as strings, e.g. `"2026-10-07 13:45:30.123"`.
